## 1 Installing and Loading R Packages

```{r}
remotes::install_github('uva-bi-sdad/catchment')
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tmap, SpatialAcc, sf,
               accessibility, tidyverse, catchment)
```

## 2 Geospatial Data Wrangling

### 2.1 Importing geospatial data

Three geospatial data sets are imported. Each shapefile is read with `st_read()` of **sf**:

```{r}
mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r}
hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                    layer = "hexagons") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r}
eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial",
                     layer = "ELDERCARE") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

### 2.2 Cleaning and updating attribute fields of the geospatial data

`eldercare` and `hexagons` contain many redundant fields. Hence, only the essential fields from each data set are retained. A new field called `capacity` and a new field called `demand` are added to `eldercare` and `hexagons` respectively. Both fields are derived with `mutate()` of **dplyr**.

```{r}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)
```

```{r}
hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```

## 3 Aspatial Data Handling and Wrangling

`OD_Matrix.csv` is imported with `read_csv()` of **readr**. The imported object is a tibble data frame called `ODMatrix`.

```{r}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```

```{r}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```

```{r}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```

```{r}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")
```

## 4 Modelling and Visualising 2-Step Floating Catchment Area (2SFCA)

The extent of the `hexagons` simple feature data frame is extracted with `st_bbox()` of **sf**:

```{r}
mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to eldercare: 2SFCA method") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

## 5 Modelling and Visualising Enhanced 2-Step Floating Catchment Area (E2SFCA)

```{r}
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))
df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

hex_e2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_e2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "E2SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to eldercare: E2SFCA method") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = "gaussian") %>%

  rename("KD2SFCA" = ".")

## 7 Modelling and Visualising 3-Step Floating Catchment Area

```{r}
df_3sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km, step_weights,
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("3SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

hex_3SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_3sfca)

tm_shape(hex_3SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "3SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to eldercare: 3SFCA method") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +

  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```
